title: Sunscreen SPF50

drivers.name: 30% off promotion
drivers.evidence: Deeper discount than past 25% off (x1.06) and 30% off (x1.26); heatwave likely amplifies effect; noise-adjusted past promotion lift x1.02, but context is stronger.

drivers.name: Heatwave forecast (38°C)
drivers.evidence: Extreme heat drives sunscreen demand; no past heatwave data, but seasonal pattern (Aug–Sep peaks) and recent high temps support uplift.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median of 24.9 is elevated by a 30% discount (27.1% below regular price) and a heatwave forecast (38°C). Past promotions show a noise-adjusted lift of x1.02, but this 30% off is deeper than previous ones (max 25%), and the heatwave is a strong demand driver. The past promotion lift was modest (x1.02), but the combination with extreme heat likely increases demand beyond historical patterns. No pantry-loading effect is expected, as this is not a repeat promotion. The classical model's x1.02 is too conservative given the strong external drivers. Adjust upward with caution due to limited past data on 30% off + heat.
